title: Maison du Chemin
area: End of a quiet lane, close to the village
features: Main villa of about 336 m² with four en suite bedrooms
Second villa of about 239 m² with five bedrooms
Wellness level below the main villa
short: Two Provençal houses at the end of a quiet lane, each with its own lawn and pool, near the village.
long: At the end of a quiet lane near the village, two houses stand in a garden of lawn, old trees and agapanthus. The main house, of some 336 square metres, keeps four bedrooms with their own bathrooms, a wellness level below and a long pool on the grass. The second house, of some 239 square metres, has a bright living room, five bedrooms and a pool of its own. Both were completed in 2024, in pale render with soft grey shutters.

title: Les Arcades
features: A sheltered cove about 300 metres on foot
short: A white house among umbrella pines above the sea at Ramatuelle, with arched loggias and a long lawn.
long: In La Quessine, a few minutes from the beaches of Pampelonne, a white Mediterranean house sits in a park of about one hectare, among umbrella pines, olives and clipped cypress. Arched loggias open onto a long lawn and the sea beyond it. There are some 400 square metres of living space, a guest house of five bedrooms, a fitness room and a pool of 120 square metres. A sheltered cove for swimming lies about three hundred metres away on foot.
source_agency: Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty (also Michaël Zingraf Real Estate, ref MZIST1846)

title: La Pinède
features: Fireplaces in the living and dining rooms
Views over vineyards and toward the sea
short: A stone house among umbrella pines near Pampelonne, looking over vineyards toward the sea.
long: Near the beach of Pampelonne, this house of stone and pale render stands in a hectare of umbrella pines, olives and Mediterranean garden. Wisteria covers the long terrace where the table is laid. Inside, fireplaces warm the living and dining rooms, and four bedrooms each have their own bathroom, with an independent studio beside them. A heated saltwater pool lies below the house, and beyond the pines the vineyards run down toward the sea.

title: Le Mas Rose
area: Between the village and the beaches of l'Escalet and Pampelonne
features: Dining room opening onto the terraces
Pool in a flat, planted garden
Summer kitchen and outdoor dining under the pergola
Permit granted to extend to about 240 m²
short: A rose coloured Provençal house in a flat green garden near the village of Ramatuelle and its beaches.
long: Between the old village of Ramatuelle and the beaches of l'Escalet and Pampelonne, this Provençal house sits in a flat garden of 2,806 square metres, with cypress, umbrella pines and vineyards close by. Inside are a lounge with a fireplace, a dining room that opens to the terraces and seven bedrooms over two floors. Outside, a pool lies on the lawn and a summer room waits under a reed pergola, with a table long enough for everyone. Saint-Tropez is about ten minutes away.
